purpose: Define the single canonical route for SENA general-core integration through Nervo Vago/VagusBus to existing SOUL compute and prefrontal decision authorities.
invariants: SENA is an optional capability, not a new SOUL nucleus or control plane.
Nervo Vago and VagusBus are one logical signal transport; do not create a second bus.
SOUL Mesh 1.1.0 remains the canonical request/response and federation contract owned by N07.
SuperGPU owns compute admission and scheduling; SENA must not allocate resources directly or infer idle capacity from a fixed percentage.
Neocortex Prefrontal owns evaluation, inhibition, prioritization and commit; SENA outputs are candidates, not commands.
HortaCore remains the authoritative state persistence path; SARA remains regeneration/provenance authority; JEV retains typed decision guardrails.
No live path is REAL until authenticated E2E evidence verifies every hop, hashes, deadlines, provenance and rollback.

route.operation: execute admitted inference or offline evaluation

route.to: HortaCore via existing N07/N01 persistence path

front_dependencies.role: Public capability federation and adapter/source verification
front_dependencies.integration_rule: SENA consumes only verified pinned adapters; do not alter shared registries or gitlinks in this SENA branch.

front_dependencies.role: GRCE compile boundary and SARA execution gates
front_dependencies.integration_rule: Wait for reconciled GRCE/SARA evidence before any decision-affecting SENA route.
Compare/compose with native neural pipeline; do not create a competing neural authority.
Reuse actual decision, inhibition, evaluation and commit telemetry; no duplicate counters or decision engine.
Respect DEGRADED/READY semantics and existing peer-adapter ownership.

front_dependencies.role: N07 to N01 HortaCore RGO E2E
front_dependencies.integration_rule: Use the existing StageEnvelope, CallWithCorrelation and evidence chain; do not add a new persistence route.

promotion_gates: Resolve and inspect the latest heads of all referenced PRs before merging or rebasing.
Verify actual VagusBus/Nervo Vago envelope schema and SuperGPU admission API from current source, not this proposal alone.
Verify actual Prefrontal candidate/decision API and telemetry contract.
Add adapter contract tests for correlation propagation, payload bounds, deadlines, cancellation, retries and duplicate delivery.
Run authenticated E2E SENA -> VagusBus -> SuperGPU -> SENA -> Prefrontal -> SARA ETR/JEV -> HortaCore, with hashes and evidence at every hop.
Keep shadow output non-authoritative and prove kill switch/fallback; keep online training disabled until separately approved.
Mark route REAL only after the authenticated E2E test and all required CI gates pass.
forbidden: Second Mesh, second VagusBus, second HortaCore, or second persistent memory authority.
SENA writing directly to HortaCore or bypassing Prefrontal, SARA ETR, or JEV.
Direct GPU allocation by SENA outside SuperGPU admission.
Treating model confidence, unit tests, registry presence or health status as E2E proof.
